{{Current events header|2015|08|31}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2015 Bangkok bombing]]
**[[Law enforcement in Thailand|Thai police]] say they have discovered bomb-making material in a raid in an apartment in an outer side of [[Bangkok]]. [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/0d73cf86a80f4b218055c572bb962ed4/latest-thai-police-find-bomb-materials-2nd-apartment (AP)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Denali]], the highest mountain peak in [[North America]], officially regains its original [[Alaska Native]] name through an [[executive order]] issued by [[President of the United States|American President]] [[Barack Obama]]. Previously, since 1917, it had been known as Mount McKinley. [http://nytimes.com/2015/08/31/us/mount-mckinley-will-be-renamed-denali.html?referrer= (''The New York Times'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2015 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Fred (2015)|Hurricane Fred]] hits [[Cape Verde]] causing flooding and the closure of airports. [http://www.nytimes.com/aponline/2015/08/31/world/africa/ap-af-cape-verde-tropical-weather.html?gwh=36440C34758F32C549F3F002BB051538&gwt=pay  (AP via ''New York Times'')]

;International relations
*[[Turkey–PKK conflict]]
**Two reporters and a support worker for ''[[Vice News]]'' are charged with being members of [[Islamic State of Iraq and Levant]] by a judge in Turkey, following their arrest a few days prior. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/08/detained-vice-news-staff-turkish-court-150831113044822.html (Al Jazeera English Online)]
*[[Minsk II]] implementation
**Riot police clash with protesters armed with firecrackers and petrol bombs outside the [[Verkhovna Rada building|parliament building]], in [[Kiev]], [[Ukraine]], leaving one [[National Guard of Ukraine|national guardsman]] dead and around 100 people injured. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/08/deadly-protest-ukraine-decentralisation-law-150831132200366.html (Al Jazeera English Online)] [https://www.the-newshub.com/politics/dozens-of-policemen-wounded-as-extreme-nationalists-and-police-battle-in-the-center-of-kiev (The News Hub)] [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-34105925 (BBC)]
*Syria–North Korea relations
**A park in [[Damascus]] is named after the North Korean founding leader [[Kim Il-Sung]]. [http://www.aljazeera.com/news/2015/08/syria-names-park-capital-korea-founder-150831194857490.html (Al Jazeera English Online)]

;Law and crime
*Kevin Dahlgren, who is suspected of killing [[Harok family murder|four Czech family members]], has been [[Extradition law in the United States#International extradition|extradited from the United States]] to face trial. [http://news.yahoo.com/us-murder-suspect-extradited-czech-republic-122207203.html (Yahoo news)] [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2015/08/31/us-murder-suspect-extradited-to-czech-republic/ (Fox news)]
*[[White supremacist]] [[Frazier Glenn Miller, Jr.]] (also known as Frazier Glenn Cross) is convicted of three counts of murder outside two [[Jews|Jewish]] centres in the American state of [[Kansas]]. [http://news.yahoo.com/murder-charges-against-white-supremacist-jury-kansas-193612145.html (AP via Yahoo! News)]
*At least three people are dead and three people injured in the [[Churachandpur district]] of [[India]]'s [[Manipur State]] following riots after the passage of three bills in the [[Manipur Legislative Assembly]] yesterday. [http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/violence-in-south-manipur-houses-of-minister-2-lawmakers-set-on-fire-1212872 (NDTV)]

;Science and technology
*According to a new study, the [[Sumatran Rhino]] is now considered extinct in the wild in [[Malaysia]]. No new wild animals have been spotted since 2007, elsewhere fewer than 100 Rhinos remain in the wild. [http://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/sumatran-rhino-goes-extinct-in-the-wild-in-malaysia/ar-AAdNGVY?ocid=iehp (MSN)].
